# For each not liked song, set rating to 1 by creating/updating reviews
results=[]
for s in not_liked:
    song_id=s['song_id']
    title=s.get('title','') or s.get('album_title','')
    # Fetch all reviews for this song by user_email (paginate)
    user_reviews=[]
    page=0
    while True:
        page_res=apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=song_id,user_email=user_email,page_index=page,page_limit=20)
        if not page_res:
            break
        user_reviews.extend(page_res)
        page+=1

    if not user_reviews:
        # create review with rating 1
        resp=apis.spotify.review_song(song_id=song_id,rating=1,access_token=access_token,title='',text='')
        results.append({'song_id':song_id,'action':'created','resp':resp})
        print('CREATED rating 1 for',song_id,'|',title,'->',resp)
    else:
        # update any review rating >1
        for r in user_reviews:
            current=r.get('rating')
            rid=r['song_review_id']
            # current may be float
            if current is None or float(current) > 1.0:
                resp=apis.spotify.update_song_review(review_id=rid,access_token=access_token,rating=1,title=None,text=None)
                results.append({'song_id':song_id,'action':'updated','review_id':rid,'from':current,'resp':resp})
                print('UPDATED rating to 1 for',song_id,'|',title,'review',rid,'from',current,'->',resp)
            else:
                print('NO CHANGE for',song_id,'|',title,'review',rid,'already',current)

print('total actions',len(results))
print('actions summary',[(r['song_id'],r['action']) for r in results])
